item: Personal LifeStraw water filter for each crew member
rationale: The communal team LifeStraw did not arrive via the Yellowknife cargo in time; most crew members had personal LifeStraws and that redundancy saved the objective. The brief's lesson is to maintain personal redundancy for communal safety and water-related kit.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 803-808, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; Flashline corroboration: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 29-06-2024 (cargo check at Resolute Bay)
